objective: Preallocate the correlated EXISTS join outer-probe column set from known join schema width.

tasks.title: Preallocate subquery outer-probe column set
tasks.result: Correlated EXISTS join probe classification now preallocates its extracted-column set from the combined local join schema width.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The capacity hint is bounded by left_schema.columns.len() + right_schema.columns.len(), using saturating_add.
The optimization only changes the initial HashSet allocation for extracted columns; EXISTS and NOT EXISTS semantics are unchanged.
